posts.title: Chicago Open House
posts.description: On October 17, 2026, I took the train into the LaSalle Street Station. From there, I completed a two mile loop and captured these photographs within that three hour walk. Some of the interior spaces were accessible because the Chicago Architecture Center was hosting the Chicago Open House event that weekend.
